PARIS, Oct 13 (Reuters) - US chipmaker Nvidia [(NVDA.O), opens new tab](https://www.reuters.com/markets/companies/NVDA.O) ‌has agreed to buy stakes in French technology startups Doctolib and Genesis ​AI, the two French companies ​said on Tuesday.

Doctolib said that ⁠Nvidia had agreed to ​buy a minority stake without specifying the ​size of the stake or its value, though it said the presence ​of Nvidia would help ​it to develop artificial intelligence tools.

Genesis AI confirmed ‌an ⁠earlier report from Les Echos newspaper. "We are excited that Nvidia is a strategic investor in ​Genesis ​AI," it ⁠said in a statement.
